column1: # The bots' languages (playerbot_i18n.h). A name, a space or tab, a number.
# /opt/m2spool/playerbot_i18n.tsv, when there is one, is read after this file
# and wins; a change of either is picked up within a minute.
# ENABLED              1: lines are translated for their readers; 0: all Polish, as before
# DETECT               1: a whisper clearly in a catalog's language is answered in it
#                         (and noted for 30 minutes), whatever the client said
# FALLBACK             a line the catalog cannot translate whole: 0 said in Polish, 1 not said
# The world's language - the shout / trade chat / over the bots' heads, a guild's chat
# with nobody online - is the server's default, M2_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE in .env (Polish when
# not set); a whisper is answered in the reader's own language.
# PUBLIC_FOREIGN_PCT   share of the bots (0-100) that speak another language on the
#                         shout / trade chat / over their heads; 0 = all in the world's language
# PUBLIC_NEED_PLAYERS  1: those bots speak the languages of the players online only
#                         (and the world's language while nobody of another language plays)
# LOG_MISSES           1: lines without a translation go to /opt/m2spool/playerbot_i18n_miss_<lang>.tsv
ENABLED
DETECT
FALLBACK
PUBLIC_FOREIGN_PCT
PUBLIC_NEED_PLAYERS
LOG_MISSES
